Refactor project structure and update configurations

- Updated app name, bundle identifier, and copyright year in AppInfo.xcconfig.
- Removed unnecessary methods from AppDelegate.swift.
- Updated Runner.xcscheme to reflect new app name.
- Cleaned up RunnerTests.swift by removing outdated tests and adding a placeholder.
- Updated pubspec.yaml and pubspec.lock to reflect new project name and dependencies.
- Removed unused web assets including favicon and icons.
- Cleaned up index.html and manifest.json files from the web directory.
- Updated CMakeLists.txt and resource files for Windows to match new project name.
- Added .metadata and Podfile.lock for project tracking and dependency management.
